data.name: Knockdown Stance
data.description: You can focus on toppling your foes. Once per round, your can make a trip attack against one target in place of a melee attack. If you succeed, the target is knocked prone. This trip attempt doesn't provoke an attack of opportunity. This is a stance rage power.
